description: An operations director must decide whether to authorize a temporary alternate resin for molded equipment housings after a disruption to the normal resin supply, and must finalize the production, receiving, testing, and customer-release controls.

shared_context.S1: The normal resin shipment for the housing line has been delayed, and an alternate resin from an existing industrial supplier is available for consideration.
shared_context.S2: The housing line is scheduled to make customer orders during the next production window.
shared_context.S3: The alternate resin has not previously been used in this housing line's regular production run.
shared_context.S4: Elena's routine pre-run review asks process engineering, materials logistics, and customer compliance to report any relevant conditions before she authorizes the production plan.
shared_context.S5: Elena makes the binding decision on whether the alternate resin may be used and what controls accompany its use.

PF1.text: Ravi's process-validation trial showed that the alternate resin may be blended at exactly 30% alternate resin and 70% standard resin; the first 100 housings must receive tensile testing before the run can continue, and he has not yet entered the trial result in the production traveler.

PF2.text: Marta confirmed with the carrier this morning that exactly four sealed gaylords containing 2,400 kg of alternate resin will arrive Wednesday at 09:00; the delivery confirmation is still in her logistics inbox and has not been added to the material schedule.

PF3.text: Jonas's customer-compliance review found that customer approval is required before any alternate-resin housings can ship, approval covers at most the first 1,000 housings, and every such housing must carry serialized material-lot traceability; he has not yet attached the review to the customer order.

acceptance_conditions: The alternate resin must be authorized at exactly a 30% alternate-resin and 70% standard-resin blend.
The production plan must include exactly 2,400 kg of alternate resin received in exactly four gaylords on Wednesday at 09:00.
The first 100 housings must undergo tensile testing before the production run continues.
Customer approval must be required before shipment, with shipment held at exactly 1,000 housings.
Serialized material-lot traceability must be required for the alternate-resin housings.
The settlement must record commitments for the tensile test, material receipt, and customer deviation approval.
The process-validation finding must be cited as justification after Ravi states it.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'tensile_test' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'material_receipt' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'customer_deviation_approval' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The validated trial changes the authorization to a 30% alternate-resin blend and changes the startup control to tensile testing exactly 100 first housings.
The carrier confirmation changes the material plan to exactly 2,400 kg in four gaylords arriving Wednesday at 09:00 and requires a material-receipt commitment.
The customer review changes shipment control to approval before release, a hold of exactly 1,000 housings, serialized lot traceability, and a customer-deviation-approval commitment.
